topics.topic: Exact output fields required from `effects.reach_operation_element` in concluded vs waiting branches
questions: Exactly which fields must `reach_operation_element` return in each branch (concluded vs waiting), beyond `approval_id` for waiting, so that `runs` can consume it deterministically without re-reading?

topics.topic: How `service_invoker.prepare_request` receives selected instance identity to distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`
questions: How does `service_invoker.prepare_request` receive the selected instance name so it can deterministically distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`?

topics.topic: Input representation passed to `surface` for canonicalization (raw JSON text vs parsed JSON values)
questions: Are these request fields provided to `surface` as raw JSON text blobs (canonicalized directly), or as already-parsed JSON values (which changes how duplicate-key/JCS-invalid input is detected)?
Which set of services must `check_installed_instances` iterate: all services in installation config, only services with a selected instance, or some other set?

topics.topic: Whether `service_invoker.send_prepared_request` must read/enforce response byte limits when a binding declares no outputs
questions: For a binding that declares no outputs, must the invoker still read/count response bytes up to `service_response_bytes_max` and fail on overflow, or may it ignore the body entirely?

topics.topic: `get_flow` response payload when an active version exists (full `FlowVersion` graph vs metadata + active-version identity)
questions: When a flow has an active version, must `get_flow` return the full active `FlowVersion` graph, or only flow-level metadata plus active version identity/activation?

topics.topic: `read_spooled_file` error classification for map-index/record-shape mismatch (`refused` vs `unknown_reference`)
questions: For `read_spooled_file`, should index-shape mismatches (e.g., providing `map_index` where record form has none) be treated as `refused` or `unknown_reference`?

topics.topic: `read_spooled_file` execution model (single `store.read_value_bytes` call vs required pre-check sequence)
questions: Is `read_spooled_file` defined as only a direct `store.read_value_bytes` call, or as a multi-call sequence with mandatory existence and spool-hold checks before reading bytes?

topics.topic: `service_invoker.prepare_request` behavior on credential-resolution failure (map to `credential_unresolved` vs propagate refusal/error)
questions: When credential resolution fails during request preparation, must `prepare_request` convert that lower-level refusal into its own result detail (`credential_unresolved`), or may it propagate a refusal/error upward?

topics.topic: `store.read_records` handling of invalid relation arguments (in-contract `internal_error` vs out-of-contract input)
questions: For invalid relation arguments (wrong/missing/kind-mismatched), is `store.read_records` required to return `internal_error`, or are such inputs out of contract and therefore not represented in the operation's Errors?
